policies.text: Digital expansion eligibility requires secure digital systems along with outpatient service authorization.
Facility licensing renewal is granted to candidates achieving full operational eligibility.
Rigorous health record oversight is established when annual record reviews reach 15 or more.
Full operational eligibility requires verified hygiene compliance alongside outpatient service authorization.

Clinical accreditation is granted either with a yearly safety audit count of at least 40 along with an annual compliance evaluation benchmark of 80 points or higher, or with Joint Commission accreditation.
Sanitation excellence certification is awarded to entities demonstrating high cleanliness standards.
Advanced digital care hub status requires sound data management combined with technology modernization grant entitlement.
High cleanliness standards are recognized when quarterly sanitation inspections reach 10 or more alongside at least 3 infection control specialists.
High prescription safety compliance requires an error-free dispensing frequency of at least 99.5 percent.
Community outreach recognition is awarded to facilities conducting at least 25 annual wellness workshops.
Modern facility designation is bestowed upon candidates possessing digital expansion eligibility.
Outpatient service authorization is issued when basic regulatory approval is met and liability protection is at least 3000000 USD.
Hygiene compliance is verified if a facility retains at least 3 infection control specialists.
Pharmaceutical storage clearance requires continuous temperature monitoring logs with zero deviations per quarter.
Basic regulatory approval requires recognized clinical status together with a privacy assessment rating of 85 points or above.
Accredited laboratory standing is conferred to entities possessing ISO 15189 laboratory certification.
Digital infrastructure security is confirmed when system availability is at least 99.0 percent and yearly cyber security breaches do not exceed 5.

Data governance approval is granted either with at least 10 annual security instruction workshops, Joint Commission accreditation, and a minimum data protection staffing level of 2, or with ISO 27001 certification.
Technology modernization grants are disbursed to institutions holding modern facility designation.
